title: Small perturbations x + tZ(x) of the identity by a compactly supported C¹ field are bi-Lipschitz bijections with injective derivative (parent steps 1–2)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be of class C¹ with compact support. Then there is t₀ > 0 such that for every t ∈ ℝ with |t| < t₀ the map Φ_t(x) := x + tZ(x) satisfies: (i) Φ_t is bijective; (ii) its derivative DΦ_t(x) is an injective linear map for every x ∈ ℝ^P; (iii) there is Λ ≥ 0 such that Φ_t is Λ-Lipschitz and Λ-antilipschitz, i.e. |Φ_t(a) − Φ_t(b)| ≤ Λ|a − b| and |a − b| ≤ Λ|Φ_t(a) − Φ_t(b)| for all a, b ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → HasCompactSupport Z → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → Bijective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)) ∧ ∃ Λ : NNReal, LipschitzWith Λ (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ AntilipschitzWith Λ (fun x => x + t • Z x)
